program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time, seed, state }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = time; const tossedHeight = launchSpeed * t - (gravity * t * t) / 2; const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; let dropHeight = apexHeight; let dropVelocity = 0; let dropAcceleration = 0; if (t >= apexTime) { const dt = t - apexTime; dropHeight = apexHeight - (gravity * dt * dt) / 2; dropVelocity = -gravity * dt; dropAcceleration = -gravity; } let tossState = "Rising"; if (t === 0) tossState = "At launch"; else if (Math.abs(tossedVelocity) < 0.05) tossState = "At the top"; else if (tossedVelocity < 0) tossState = "Falling"; if (tossedHeight <= 0 && t > 0) tossState = "At launch height"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (t > apexTime && Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.05) dropState = "Just released"; else if (t > apexTime) dropState = "Falling together"; if (dropHeight <= 0 && t > apexTime) dropState = "At launch height"; const hScale = 120; const baseY = 340; const tossX = 180; const dropX = 460; const ballY = (y) => baseY - y * hScale; const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 50, y: 50, w: 260, h: 350, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 330, y: 50, w: 260, h: 350, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.toss", { x: tossX, y: baseY, length: 264, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.drop", { x: dropX, y: baseY, length: 264, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX, ballY(Math.max(0, tossedHeight)), 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX, ballY(Math.max(0, dropHeight)), 28, { role: "output" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX - 20, y: ballY(Math.max(0, tossedHeight)) }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 20, y: ballY(Math.max(0, tossedHeight)) }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX - 20, y: ballY(Math.max(0, dropHeight)) }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 20, y: ballY(Math.max(0, dropHeight)) }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 15, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(tossX + 45, ballY(Math.max(0, tossedHeight)) - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(tossedVelocity) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(tossedAcceleration) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(dropX + 45, ballY(Math.max(0, dropHeight)) - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(dropVelocity) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(dropAcceleration) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.drop" })); if (t >= apexTime) { objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate", dropX, ballY(apexHeight), { open: true, label: "Release gate" })); } else { objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate", dropX, ballY(apexHeight), { open: false, label: "Release gate" })); } return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, apexTime, apexHeight, tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: At the top, velocity is zero for an instant, but gravity keeps changing it: a = -g. The gate releases a second ball at that moment.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball side by side, with velocity and acceleration vectors and readouts.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
